lines.text: Jeremiah urges Judah to listen and not be arrogant, or he will weep in secret over the captive flock.
The king and the queen mother are told to take a lowly seat, and the cities of the Negev are shut tight.
Judah is told to look at those coming from the east and asked where the flock entrusted to them is.
Their great iniquity brought exposure, and the LORD will scatter them like chaff because they have honored Him and trusted falsehood.
The LORD says He has seen their detestable acts and asks Jerusalem how long it will remain unclean.
